features.description: Every Claude Code session in this repo is a governed run: hooks post run_started, gate_waiting, gate_passed and run_completed to POST /events sharing run_id = session id, and the session writes its ops_skill_runs row at the end
steps: chmod +x .claude/hooks/ledger.sh; jq is installed; EVENTS_BEARER_TOKEN is in .env
Start a session, run one command that prompts for permission, approve it, then /exit

Compass list_records(ops_run_events, skill='agent-world-build') shows run_started, gate_waiting {surface:'class_b_gate'}, gate_passed {result:'approved'}, run_completed — all with the same run_id, none carrying command text or file contents
The session's ops_skill_runs row exists with id = that run_id, skill 'agent-world-build', run_class 'B_judge', trigger 'claude_code'
Resume the same session: no second run_started row (duplicate id ignored by the Worker)

features.description: Worker ledger-read proxy — in tellefsen-compass-mcp, not this fork: GET /ledger/scan?since= returns {events, rows} using the Worker's own already-configured SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, behind the same bearer token /events uses. Added because the Compass Supabase project is provisioned through Lovable, which exposes no Supabase URL or service-role key outside itself — this is what lets U3 work without any Supabase access on the local machine.
steps: worker/ledger-read.mjs dropped into tellefsen-compass-mcp; one import + one router line added per worker/WIRING.md; wrangler deploy

curl with no Authorization header → 401; curl with a wrong Bearer token → 401; curl with the right token and no since → 400; curl with the right token and a valid since → 200 with a body starting {"events":[

The 200 response's events array matches what list_records(ops_run_events) shows for the same window (spot-check a handful of ids); rows contains exactly the ops_skill_runs rows for run_ids present in events, nothing else
The response never contains the string SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY or anything shaped like a Supabase key
A malformed since (not parseable as a date) → 400, not a 500 or a hang

features.description: Ledger to agents and badges: events in the window fold into runs; each run is one thread on its client's plot (or Tellefsen HQ); badges follow the precedence table; running requires activity within the TTL; the viewer context defaults to Owner; the scan is cached 5 s (needs U10 deployed on the Worker first, since reads go through it, not Postgres directly).
steps: scripts/zztest-seed.sh posts Alpha (run_started + gate_waiting pending_approval, client ZZTEST Client), Beta (run_started only, same client), Gamma (run_started + run_failed, client null), Delta (run_started + run_completed, at = 4 days ago, client ZZTEST Client) and prints their run_ids

node -e scan (README 'Checking your work' step 3) returns 4 compass threads with no undefined fields; Alpha.unread=true, Beta.running=true, Gamma.hasError=true, Delta.lastActivityAt older than 3 days; Alpha/Beta/Delta.project='ZZTEST Client', Gamma.project='Tellefsen HQ'
npm test: test/adapter.test.mjs is green against test/fixtures/events.zztest.json (the same four runs plus an unmatched gate_passed and a malformed payload that must be skipped)

In the browser: ZZTEST Client plot with Alpha holding ?, Beta hammering, Delta asleep; Gamma slumped with ! on Tellefsen HQ; HUD 'need you' = 1; two consecutive polls within 5 s issue one Supabase query burst (log)
Post run_completed for Beta: within one poll Beta stops hammering and shows idle, no badge
features.built_in_sandbox: 2026-09-06 — fold/threads/viewer/supabase written; fixture test green; real-data dry run over 23 live events / 9 runs green (correct zones, gate matching incl. a surface-less gate, no undefined fields). Remaining for the Mac: seed ZZTEST, open the world, V-U3.

features.description: Open goes to the surface and nothing writes back: Enter/Open opens the newest open gate's ref_url, else the newest artifact's Notion page, else the Claude Project for chat runs; a run with nothing to open is greyed; A, new-session and archive never touch the substrate or the ledger
steps: Select Alpha, press Enter: the browser opens the ZZTEST Pending Approval row URL from its gate's ref_url
Post artifact_registered for Beta with a notion_url, select Beta, press Enter: that Notion page opens
Seed a run with trigger 'chat' and no gate or artifact: Enter opens CLAUDE_PROJECT_URL; a claude_code run with nothing to open shows the Open button greyed and the toast names why
Press A on any compass thread: nothing happens beyond the toast; data/colony.json 'archived' stays empty; no request other than GET reached Supabase, Notion or Airtable (adapter debug log)
Reload the page: every plot is where it was (data/colony.json plots persisted)
features.built_in_sandbox: 2026-09-06 — openThread/newSession/setArchived and the link-only Open resolution written; canArchive false. Remaining for the Mac: V-U5.

features.description: Selection panel overlay (the first overlay module, per the seam Decision): when a figure is selected, a panel outside src/ shows the run's skill, zone, state, source, model, time — and for a pending gate, the gate's name and the full instruction of what the human must do. Blocks the A (hide) key on a waiting run. Pulled forward from M2 into M1 at Christoffer's request after V-U5 ('the info boxes cut the guidance text so build something better there').
steps: index.html mounts /overlay/main.js after /src/main.js; npm test still shows src/ byte-identical and no model endpoints; npm run build bundles the overlay

Select any figure: the panel appears bottom-left with skill, zone, status chip, source, model, 'ago', short run id, and an Open button labelled by destination (Airtable / Notion / Claude Project) or disabled

Select a ? figure: the panel shows 'What it wants from you', the gate name, and the full instruction (e.g. 'A Pending Approval row is waiting. Open it in Airtable and set its Status to Approved or Rejected.'); Bot Crossing's own card shows the short tag (e.g. 'approve in Airtable') untruncated
Select a non-? figure and press A: Bot Crossing's local hide still works (toast, figure walks to the ship)
Select a ? figure and press A: nothing is hidden; a toast says the run is waiting on you; the figure stays
Deselect (click empty ground): the panel disappears

features.description: Milestone progress seam: the run card's bar equals Engagement Milestones Done ÷ total for the run's Notion project, read from Notion and cached 5 minutes; runs without a project show the floor
steps: surfaces.mjs: progress(projectId) normalises dashed/undashed, GETs the project page's Milestones relation (follows has_more), GETs each milestone's Status; done = Delivered/Done/Accepted/Complete ÷ total; floor 0.05; 5-min cache; a 404 (Projects DB not shared) degrades to the floor with a warning naming the fix
test/surfaces.test.mjs green: 1 of 4 → 0.25 from an undashed id; the dashed id hits the cache; null → floor; unshared → floor without throwing; all GETs
On the Mac with the Projects DB shared: an agent-world-build run's bar reads 25 %; Gamma's reads 5 %

features.description: Surface cross-check: an open gate whose Pending Approval row is Approved/Sent/Rejected, or whose Decision is Active/Superseded, stops rendering ? within one poll — before the daily sweep writes gate_passed — and the world writes nothing Content rows (content_status) added 2026-09-06 after Christoffer signed a draft and the ? stayed: the poller owns the write, the world may read.
steps: surfaces.mjs: gateResolved reads Airtable (pending_approval), the Notion Decision (decision), the Notion Content row (content_status); class_b_gate/client_gate never; every request a GET; resolved cached, open re-read each scan; failures warn once a minute and leave the ?

test/surfaces.test.mjs green: each surface resolves on its own moved-on state; the negative answers come from a real read; no request for class_b_gate/client_gate; a thrown read returns false; resolved is cached
Real-surface proof: a signed Content row → true; ZZTEST Alpha (Pending Approval) → false; an Active Decision → true

features.description: Realtime nudge: the adapter subscribes to postgres_changes on ops_run_events and drops its scan cache on insert, so the next poll reflects an event that landed seconds ago; this demonstrates Realtime delivery to a subscriber (M0's open check)
steps: Server log shows 'realtime: subscribed ops_run_events' within 5 s of start and reconnects after a forced disconnect
Post an event via /events: the log shows the insert received within 2 s and 'scan cache invalidated'
The next /api/threads (poll) reflects the event without waiting for the 5 s cache to expire
With Realtime unreachable (bad URL) the world still works on the 5 s cache and logs once

features.description: Worker write-gate (tellefsen-compass-mcp, not this fork): a Pending Approval status change made through airtable_update_record writes gate_passed for its open gates within seconds and patches the ledger row, so the ledger learns of MCP taps without the daily sweep; Airtable-UI taps stay with the sweep
steps: RUN_GOVERNANCE_RULES.late_tap_mapping.gate_passed_at lists at_source 'worker' (Compass key first, then code)

In tellefsen-compass-mcp: airtable_update_record on table_key pending_approval with merged Status in (Approved, Rejected, Sent) inserts gate_passed {result approved|rejected, at_source 'worker'} for every open gate_waiting whose ref_url contains the record id, then patches ops_skill_runs per late_tap_mapping.ledger_patch

Approve the ZZTEST Alpha row via the Compass MCP: within 5 s list_records(ops_run_events, run_id=Alpha) shows exactly one gate_passed with at_source 'worker'; Alpha's ledger row has gates_hit 1 and gates_detail filled
Run the same update again (idempotent): no second gate_passed; the next gate-reconciliation sweep leaves the gate alone
A pending_approval update whose Status stays Pending Approval writes nothing; an update on any other table_key writes nothing
Worker deploy + a smoke run recorded in the PR; the Worker's own tests green
